logLocation: Root primary, project fallback: the root of your Claude Projects folder when it's connected (one log aggregates every project), otherwise the project folder itself. tools/merge_pending.py reconciles the two.

_notes.rates: Wh per million tokens (inp=input, out=output, bl=blended). Sources: see skills/impact-tracker/references/methodology.md. NOTE: the 'bl' values sit close to the OUTPUT rate, not an 80/20 input/output mix — blended-rate entries therefore read high. Prefer logging input_tokens/output_tokens and using the split formula.
_notes.waterFactor: mL of data-center water per Wh (Li et al. 2023, arXiv:2304.03271)
_notes.gridIntensity: g CO2e per kWh for AI compute. 400 = global average (IEA). Lower it for cleaner regional grids, e.g. ~50 for hydro/nuclear-heavy grids, ~250 for California, ~650 for coal-heavy grids.
_notes.life: Real-world footprint factors for the Life Footprint panel. gridUS 367 g/kWh = US average generation (EIA 2023). elecKwhMo 881 and gasCfMo 4717 = US household averages (EPA Household Carbon Footprint Calculator); gasGPerCf 54.4 = 0.12 lb CO2 per cubic foot (EPA). carGPerMile 400 and milesYr 11500 (EPA: typical passenger vehicle = 4.6 t CO2/yr). embodiedIceKg 6000 / embodiedBevKg 10000 = manufacturing-phase emissions for a new sedan and an equivalent EV. flightLongKg 1600 = one transatlantic round trip (Wynes & Nicholas 2017); flightShortKg 300 is scaled by distance from that figure and is rougher. dietKgDay = kg CO2e/day standardised to 2000 kcal (Scarborough et al. 2023, Nature Food): high 10.24 and vegan 2.47 are reported directly, low 5.86 is the paper's 57.2% ratio, medium and vegetarian are interpolated between them. otherConsumptionKg 4000 = adjustable residual for goods, services and public infrastructure. usPerCapitaKg 15000 = order-of-magnitude US per-capita total, shown only as a reference line.
